message.content:
A vertical rectangular magazine cover features a black background with a black-and-white illustration of a man from the chest up. The man has short, dark, textured hair and is looking down at his hands. He wears a light-colored, short-sleeved collared shirt. His right hand holds a thin matchstick, which has a small, bright white and yellow flame at its tip. His left hand is cupped near the match. The man's facial features include closed or downward-looking eyes, a mustache, and visible skin texture on his cheeks.

Large white capital letters at the top center spell "TEMPO." Above this, red text reads "EDISI HARI KEMERDEKAAN." Below "TEMPO," smaller white text says "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." To the left of "TEMPO" is a colorful logo with the number "45" and the years "1971-2016." In the bottom-right, black text says "CHAIRIL ANWAR," and below it, large red text reads "BAGIMUNEGERI MENYEDIAKANAPI." 

The bottom-left corner contains a white barcode, price information "RP 45.000," the date "15-21 AGUSTUS 2016," and other publishing details. The left edge has vertical text: "TEMPO" and "CHAIRIL ANWAR."
